title: Portable Clocks
description: Adds a wrist watch item that display the time on HUD
body:
# **Description**
A mod that adds a new item, the Wrist Watch, which when equipped (either held or equipped in the Curios wrist slot) displays the current in-game time in HH:MM format on the HUD. It is craftable with one leather and one clock.

# **Disclaimer**
This mod is AI-assisted, meaning it may contain some logic assisted/created by Artificial Intelligence. However, everything excluding some code is completely created by me.

### **Note**
In the future I will not be using Artificial Intelligence to assist with programming, this is my first ever Java project and I created it for a modpack so it was somewhat rushed.
